Approval.description: What a person approved, and what it is bound to (design section 10.3).
Approval.title: Approval

ApprovalPreviewOut.description:
Everything an approval is bound to, for a person to read before approving. The four
binding fields are sent back unchanged in `ApproveIn`.
ApprovalPreviewOut.title: ApprovalPreviewOut

ContractStatus.description: The tool contract recorded for a tool server (`contract/dependencies.md` section 2.3).
ContractStatus.title: ContractStatus

Deployment.description:
A deployment of any kind. `document` is kind-specific.

agent: {agent: <the Agent document in force>}. On the pull request path it is the Agent
    last seen in git or on the cluster; under the registry it is the Agent published with
    the newest revision. It is what the provisioner is given. Each revision also keeps
    the Agent that was published with it.
tool-server: {namespace, workload, image, pinnedByDigest, registered, backend}.
model: {namespace, workload, servedName, servedNameFrom, backend}.
Deployment.title: Deployment

DesiredHold.description:
An agent to hold for an alias move: the provisioner writes its Agent with the `held`
annotation, stops its sessions when `sessions` is `cancel`, and reports how many task
sessions still run (`contract/dependencies.md` section 7).
DesiredHold.title: DesiredHold

DesiredRevocation.description:
A revoked release whose running sessions the provisioner cancels, after it has written
the release's AgentRelease (`contract/delivery.md` section 8.3).
DesiredRevocation.title: DesiredRevocation

Evaluation.description:
One attempt to evaluate one revision (`contract/delivery.md` section 6). `id` to
`created_at` are written once. The fields after the marker are progress; the store changes
them only through `Tx.set_evaluation_progress`.
Evaluation.title: Evaluation

HoldReport.description: The task sessions the provisioner counted for one hold it was asked for.
HoldReport.title: HoldReport

Impact.description: The answer of section 3.3. `reevaluated` holds agent names.
Impact.title: Impact

ObserveSubject.description: A workload the provisioner reports on and never writes.
ObserveSubject.title: ObserveSubject

Observed.description: How fresh the last observation of a subject is (`derive.freshness`).
Observed.title: Observed

Pair.description: The engine behind an alias and the release that engine serves.
Pair.title: Pair

ProjectedObject.description:
One object the provisioner applies. `document` is complete: apiVersion, kind,
metadata (name, namespace, annotations) and spec. `generation` is repeated from the
annotation so the provisioner need not parse it.
ProjectedObject.title: ProjectedObject

RecordReleaseIn.description: A published release: the two documents the release workflow attached to the tag.
RecordReleaseIn.title: RecordReleaseIn

Release.description:
One release of an item. Written once.

For an agent in milestone 1 `name` is the AgentRelease name and `document` is the published
AgentRelease with `spec.approval` removed (approval is not a fact about the release).
Release.title: Release

ReportLineageIn.description: Only the checksums are read. Any other key is ignored: the rest is the token's.
ReportLineageIn.title: ReportLineageIn

ReturnOut.description: The documents to write back to git when authority returns to the pull request path.
ReturnOut.title: ReturnOut

Revision.description:
A deployment revision. `number` to `created_at` are written once. The fields after the
marker are progress and may change; the store changes them only through
`Tx.set_revision_progress`.
Revision.title: Revision

SuiteIn.description: The evaluation suite the release carries (`contract/delivery.md` section 1.3).
SuiteIn.title: SuiteIn

get.description: No token needed. Answers 503 `unavailable` when the database cannot be reached.

post.description: A1 to A3: start the move an assessment describes.
A5: cancel a move that is holding or held.
A9: the engine is serving the candidate; evaluate the held agents on it.
Compute and store what moving the alias to the candidate would touch.
Section 8: may a change that moves the alias to the candidate merge? Writes nothing.

Which agents a proposed contract for a tool server breaks. `not-found` for an unknown
cluster or server; `invalid-arguments` when the contract is not one for that server.

get.description:
Everything the provisioner should apply and observe. If `lastGeneration` is higher
than the registry's generation the registry has gone back in time: it enters recovery
and answers with no objects.

post.description:
The oldest evaluation of the cluster that is waiting for an evaluator, or null. Null
in recovery too.

Store what the provisioner saw and did, then let each registry-owned agent of the
cluster advance. Accepted in recovery too: leaving recovery needs fresh observations.

get.description:
The agents that depend on a tool server backend (`type=tool`, `name` a backend name) or
on a model alias (`type=model`, `name` an alias). An unknown name is an empty answer, not
an error.
A deployment with its revisions (ascending) and its approvals.

post.description: Approve a revision. Refused unless the binding matches and every gate passes.
Move an agent back to the pull request path and return the documents to commit.

Move an agent from the pull request path to the registry. `conflict` unless the
registry's records equal fresh observations of the live objects.
Hold the pointer on one activated revision, or let it go.
Record a published release and create the next revision, projected unapproved.

get.description: What approving this revision would bind to, and whether it can be approved now.

post.description: D14: another evaluation of a revision the last one refused.
An evaluator's verdict. The revision moves by D9 to D12 in the same transaction.
Return to an earlier release: the given revision, or the newest earlier activated one.

get.description: One item with its releases and its deployments. `not-found` when there is none.
The mode and, in recovery, every difference between the registry and the clusters.

post.description:
Adopt what the clusters hold and return to normal. `conflict` when the digest named is
not the digest of the differences now, or the report is not complete.
Record a release the workflow published. Nothing is approved or made current.

get.description:
Per agent: the owning path, the current release, blockers and next actions. Per tool
server and model: what is declared, what was observed, and how old the observation is.
